cards.nativeTextPrompt: Title at top: 背部深层肌. Under the title, a brick-red brush underline. Main composition: the fixed coach in a posterior three-quarter pose with a precise posterior back cut-away. Show the four common intrinsic deep back-muscle groups only; do not show or label trapezius, latissimus dorsi, or any superficial-back-muscle comparison. Make broad paired longitudinal erector spinae columns the largest highlighted muscles on both sides of the spine. Add a separate medial layer of short oblique multifidus bundles next to the spinous processes, an upper-neck splenius region, and tiny segmental muscles between spinal processes. Use exactly these four framed Chinese labels: 夹肌：头夹肌、颈夹肌; 竖脊肌：髂肋肌、最长肌、棘肌; 横突棘肌：半棘肌、多裂肌、回旋肌; 节段短肌：棘间肌、横突间肌、肋提肌. Bottom brick-red TIP strip, exact white text: TIP：竖脊肌主伸背；多裂肌属于横突棘肌。

Title at top: 大收肌：固定端决定谁动. Under the title, a brick-red brush underline. Show two identical fixed coaches side by side, with pelvis and medial thigh anatomical cut-aways highlighting adductor magnus. Left labels exactly: 近固定：骨盆固定 and 主看：大腿内收. Right labels exactly: 远固定：股骨固定 and 双侧：骨盆前倾. Bottom brick-red TIP strip, exact white text: TIP：近固定看大腿；骨盆动作先看股骨是否固定。

Title at top: 上肢定位地图. Under the title, a brick-red brush underline. Three clearly framed vertical anatomy sections with the same coach demonstrating: shoulder close-up with bicipital groove and transverse humeral ligament, elbow/proximal forearm with pronator teres, and dorsal wrist bones. Exact labels: 横肱韧带：固定长头腱; 旋前圆肌：主旋前，助屈肘; 桡腕 / 腕骨间 / 腕中. Bottom brick-red TIP strip, exact white text: TIP：长头腱看横肱韧带；旋前圆肌屈肘只是辅助。

Title at top: 小腿三群与腓肠肌. Under the title, a brick-red brush underline. The same coach stands as an anatomy demonstrator beside an accurate lower-leg cross-section and posterior lower-leg inset. Exact labels: 前群：背屈; 外侧群：外翻; 后群：跖屈; 腓肠肌：屈膝 + 跖屈. Bottom brick-red TIP strip, exact white text: TIP：前群背屈、外侧群外翻、后群跖屈；腓肠肌还屈膝。

Title at top: 骨膜、骨内膜与骨细胞. Under the title, a brick-red brush underline. Create a clean, simplified textbook anatomy card only, with no injury, blood, surgery, or photorealistic tissue. The same cartoon coach points to a long-bone cut-away. Draw a clearly visible two-layer periosteum around compact bone. In one magnified callout of the periosteum inner osteogenic layer, place osteoprogenitor cells and a neat row of cuboidal osteoblasts along the outer bone surface. In a second clean schematic callout nearby, place a pink multinucleated osteoclast sitting on a shallow simplified bone-surface remodeling indentation; keep it separate from the osteoprogenitor lineage. Point separately to endosteum lining the marrow cavity. Use exactly these Chinese labels: 骨膜内层（成骨层）：骨原细胞、成骨细胞; 破骨细胞：骨表面改建／骨吸收; 骨内膜：衬骨髓腔; 骨原细胞 → 成骨细胞 → 骨细胞. Bottom brick-red TIP strip, exact white text: TIP：骨膜内层有成骨细胞；破骨细胞在骨表面改建。

Title at top: 羽状肌. Under the title, a brick-red brush underline. The same clothed cartoon coach teaches beside four clean textbook muscle-architecture diagrams of identical size. Use pale-gray tendons and brick-red muscle fibers. Diagram 1 has fibers parallel to one long tendon. Diagram 2 has oblique fibers on one side of a tendon. Diagram 3 has oblique fibers on both sides of a central tendon. Diagram 4 has several tendon branches with oblique fibers. Under each diagram, render the exact two-line Chinese label pair: 平行肌 / 例：缝匠肌; 单羽肌 / 例：伸趾长肌; 双羽肌 / 例：股直肌; 多羽肌 / 例：三角肌. Add one clear small Chinese label with a leader line: 肌束与肌腱成斜角. Bottom brick-red TIP strip, exact white text: TIP：羽状肌肌束斜接肌腱，通常更利于产生力量。

Title at top: 呼吸系统与骨连结. Under the title, a brick-red brush underline. The same coach presents two separate framed topics. Top: respiratory tract and both lungs, exact label 呼吸道 + 肺. Bottom: three bone-connection cross-sections, exact labels 直接连结（无腔）, 半关节, 关节（有关节腔）. Bottom brick-red TIP strip, exact white text: TIP：呼吸道＋肺；直接连结 → 半关节 → 关节。
